CONCEPT
Turn-key race car, single-seat based on the Porsche 911 GT2 RS (Type 991).
Continues the design heritage of the Porsche 935 race car from 1978.
BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM INTERIOR
• Lightweight hybrid aluminium-steel chassis design • Cosworth® ICD display with Logger • Gear shift knob made from milled laminated wood
• CFRP bodywork incl. rear side window panels • CFRP multi-function quick-release steering • Titanium PDK shaft
• CFRP rear wing adopted from the 911 GT3 R wheel featuring integrated pit speed limiter • Unique dash plaque design indicating Limited
• Fully integrated roll-cage (FIA Art. 277) & shift paddles Edition number
• CFRP roof with roof hatch (FIA Art. 277) • LED headlights in 4-line design incl. indicators • Lightweight racing interior parts trimmed
• 115l FT3 fuel cell in the front section • LED taillights integrated in rear wing side plates in Alcantara® and CFRP
• Three on-board air jacks • FIA rain light • Analog boost pressure indicator in addition to
• Recaro® race bucket seat with longitudinal • Electrically adjustable CFRP mirrors adopted the Porsche Sport Chrono watch
adjustment and individual padding system from the 911 RSR • Centre console mounted membrane switch
(FIA 8862-2009) • Tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) panel with LED backlit
• Six-point safety harness for use with HANS® • Air conditioning system
• Electronically activated fire extinguisher system
• Central locking system DIMENSIONS
• Weight: approx. 1,390 kg
• Length: 4,720 mm (without splitter)
• Width: 1,916 mm (front axle)/
2,001 mm (rear axle)
• Wheelbase: 2,457 mm

ENGINE
• 515 kW (700 hp) at 7,000 rpm
• 3,800 cm³ (stroke 77.5 mm, bore 102 mm)
• Water-cooled aluminium six cylinder rigidly
rear-mounted twin-turbo boxer engine
• Adjustable camshaft phasing and variable
valve timing (VarioCam Plus)
• Race optimized cooling system
• Race optimized exhaust system
“Cookie cutter megaphones”
• Redesigned water jet system incl. 20l tank
TRANSMISSION
• Rigidly mounted performance-based
7-speed PDK-gearbox with short gearshifts
• Dual mass flywheel
• Internal pressurized oil lubrication with active oil cooling
• Electronically regulated and fully variable rear differential lock
optimized for motorsport
SUSPENSION BRAKES
• Electro-hydraulic power steering • Balance bar system
• Front axle: MacPherson suspension strut • One piece aluminium six-piston
Rear axle: multi-link suspension racing calipers
• High-performance spherical bearings • Ventilated steel brake discs
• Wheel hubs with centre lock nuts front: 390 mm rear: 380 mm
• Motorsport three-way shock absorbers • Race brake pads
• Front and rear anti-roll bars, adjustable by • Optimized brake cooling
blade positions • Motorsport-optimized PSM system
WHEELS/ TIRES
• One piece forged alloy BBS® rims
front: 11.5J x 18 offset 15.3 mm
rear: 13J x 18 offset -10.0 mm
• Wheel covers, optimized for cooling
and downforce

BORN In flacht
DELIVERY PRICE CONTACT
• Exclusive 2-day delivery event with • 701,948.00 EUR • Office: +49-711-911-77-935
technical and dynamic training by a (plus VAT, ex works, incl. delivery event) • E-Mail: 935@porsche.de
personal instructor on a european • Limited to 77 cars worldwide
racetrack (deselectable upon request)
• From August 2019 onwards
Errors and omissions excepted. Subject to change Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG © Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG, 2018
